headlines.description: — Norman Powell had 25 points, rookie Caleb Wilson added 21 and the Chicago Bulls beat the Milwaukee Bucks 132-125 on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Powell scores 25 points to help the Bulls hold off the Bucks, 132-125
